1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits enhanced reactivity in [4+2] cycloaddition reactions compared to the corresponding potassium salt__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl and the sodium counterion is essential for the compound's reactivity profile__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl, __wherein the sodium salt exhibits selectivity in nucleophilic addition reactions not observed with potassium or other alkali metal counterparts__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is sodium, __wherein the sodium enolate of the β-keto methyl ester demonstrates improved stability and reactivity compared to the corresponding ethyl ester derivative__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is sodium, __wherein the methyl ester functionality in combination with the sodium counterion provides enhanced selectivity in subsequent transformations__.
